svg.text: Terrain authoring — 1 / 4: the workflow and the random-terrain wizard (DESIGN_Terrain_Authoring.md §12–§13, R-4200)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
the source scenario stays inside the terrain — edit and save again as often as needed (§14)
a few villages joined by roads
Everything the generator places — towns, villages,
farms, woods — is an ordinary block in a scenario:
move, re-roll or delete any of it later in the editor.
① Preset — six pictures, one choice. A preset decides the MIX (how much town / village / farm / wood) and the densities; there is no
building-density knob (R-4199 B-8: few choices). Plain terrain = the ground, the roads and the water only (R-4198 TA-2).
Size, Relief, Vegetation and Water are four short rows; the seed is shown so a result can be reproduced, the dice rolls a new one.
click a block to see it larger
new places for the blocks, same ground
new hills, roads and river, then a layout
② Preview — the 2-D plan in HROT's map colours (buildings by height, woods, water, roads); each block is outlined with its recipe's name (R-4200 W-2).
Shuffle layout = new seeds for the blocks on the same ground (seconds); Shuffle ground = new relief, road net and river, then a layout (netconvert, slower) (W-1).
No moving of blocks here — that is the editor's job. Open in editor writes the ground terrain and the block scenario, and opens the scenario (③).
